tasks.label: Compiler Watch
args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; if (Get-Command regolith -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { regolith watch } elseif (Get-Command dash_compiler -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { dash_compiler watch } else { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('Compiler not found: install Regolith or dash_compiler and add it to PATH.'); exit 127 }; exit $LASTEXITCODE
